item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Delete expired records and report source failures explicitly","mechanism":"Hard expiry prevents old records from appearing fresh; source failure never extends retention.","implementation":"Assign a monotonic expiry no later than 300 seconds after fetch starts. Delete on expiry and before reads. On refresh timeout, return 503 with source_timeout.","check":"With a fake clock and stalled source, verify expiration deletes the record, returns no cached payload, and produces 503.","risk":"Strict expiration sacrifices availability during outages."},{"action":"Bound admission to 100 public records","mechanism":"Atomic admission couples a public-field allowlist with deterministic least-recently-used eviction.","implementation":"Fetch only approved public endpoints and fields. Under one cache lock, purge expired entries, then evict the least-recently-used record before inserting at capacity.","check":"Insert 101 distinct records concurrently; assert occupancy never exceeds 100 and the expected victim disappears. Verify forbidden fields never enter cache or logs.","risk":"An incorrect allowlist can admit sensitive fields."},{"action":"Merge duplicate fetches and bound source work","mechanism":"One in-flight fetch per key prevents duplicate refreshes; deadlines bound waiting during source stalls.","implementation":"Share each key's fetch promise. Set a two-second source deadline and a global concurrency limit; reject excess uncached requests with 503 busy. Remove completed promises.","check":"Send simultaneous requests for one missing key; observe one source call. Stall it; verify all waiters finish and its promise is removed.","risk":"Shared fetch failures affect every waiting request."},{"action":"Temporarily stop calls to a failing source","mechanism":"A circuit breaker makes outage handling explicit without changing freshness or eviction rules.","implementation":"After three consecutive source timeouts, open for 30 seconds. Serve only unexpired hits; return 503 source_unavailable for misses. Continue expiry deletion; allow one recovery probe.","check":"Force three timeouts; verify misses make no source calls during cooldown, expired entries disappear, and a successful probe closes the breaker.","risk":"Cooldown can delay detection of source recovery."}],"abstention_reason":""}
